name: God Made Us Perfect
overview: Scripture reveals that God created humanity perfectly in His own image, male and female, reflecting His divine nature (Genesis 1:27). Each person is fearfully and wonderfully made, showcasing the marvelous works of the Creator (Psalms 139:14). Although all have sinned and fallen short of God's glory (Romans 3:23), believers are called to pursue perfection as God Himself is perfect (Matthew 5:48), recognizing that God sovereignly forms all things, both light and darkness, for His purposes (Isaiah 45:7; Proverbs 16:4).
